Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square emblem for a project of the Olympuz family
Primary request: one square emblem that reads at a glance and stays readable when shrunk - a lesson held down by the thing that closes it.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column; Image 3 is the project character sheet and Image 4 the project prop sheet - the open marble ledger, the gold pin and the axis rod must match those sheets exactly.
Subject: a single composition on a plain ivory ground: the open marble ledger lying flat and slightly tilted toward the viewer with three carved horizontal grooves on each page, one muted-gold pin driven straight through the right-hand page and standing upright out of it, and the muted-gold axis rod resting diagonally across the upper left corner of the ledger with its plain marble ring visible.
Composition/framing: perfect square, the composition centred with generous empty ivory margin on all four sides, nothing cropped, no column in this frame.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble and gold render, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, one gentle shadow under each object. Gold glows softly from within, never lit by a lamp or a hard rim light.
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for the rod and the pin only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints:
- Only three objects in the frame: ledger, pin, rod. Nothing else.
- The ledger rests on the surface and casts a shadow. The rod rests on the ledger and casts a shadow. Nothing hovers.
- The pin pierces the page and stands upright out of it; it never lies on top of the page.
- The rod is straight and unadorned with one plain smooth ring: no snakes, no wings, no engraving.
- Each page carries exactly three grooves and no writing.
- The shapes stay large and simple so the emblem survives being shrunk to a small icon.
- Preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: rainbow of many colors, prismatic colors, figures, faces, hearth, fire, flame, scales, sword, owl, wings, screens, keyboards, cables, brand marks, dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, callout labels
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits anywhere in the image.
